faq.title: Questions clinics ask us
faq.a1: Yes. Turn on online booking and share your clinic's page. Patients choose a doctor, a service and a free time; the booking arrives as pending until your team confirms it.
faq.q2: Does every staff member get their own sign-in?
faq.a2: Yes. Add staff with a role — doctor, nurse, reception, accountant or clinic manager. Each person sees only what their role allows, and a doctor sees only their own appointments.
faq.q3: Does it work fully in Arabic?
faq.a3: Yes. {brand} works in Arabic (right to left) and English, and each person can switch language at any time.
faq.q4: Can I run more than one clinic?
faq.a4: Yes. One account can belong to several clinics and switch between them, while each clinic's data stays separate.
faq.q5: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a5: No. {brand} runs in the browser on computers, tablets and phones.
faq.q6: Can I take my data out?
faq.a6: Yes. Lists and reports can be exported to Excel or CSV by the people whose role allows it.
faq.q7: Can I run more than one branch?
faq.a7: Yes. Depending on your plan, add your clinic's branches under Branches; each has its own doctors and appointments, and patients choose the branch when booking. The plan price follows the number of branches.
faq.q8: Can I change my plan later?
faq.a8: Yes. In subscription settings choose another plan or a monthly or yearly cycle; the new period starts when the paid one ends.
faq.q9: Is my clinic's data separate and protected?
faq.a9: Yes. Each clinic sees only its own data, every change is logged, and each clinic has its own encrypted daily backup that can be restored on its own.
faq.q10: How do prescriptions and invoices reach the patient?
faq.a10: From Today, reception picks the papers and sends them on WhatsApp or e-mail. The patient gets a secure link showing them in the clinic's colours, ready to print or save as PDF.
faq.q11: What do I need for the waiting-room screen?
faq.a11: Any TV or screen with a web browser. Add the screen at the front desk; the owner or clinic manager opens its link on the TV once.
faq.q12: Can I send the prescription to a pharmacy?
faq.a12: Yes. Add pharmacies, imaging centres and labs in Settings, then send the prescription or request from its page on WhatsApp or e-mail through a secure link. A centre inside the clinic sees requests on its own list.
faq.q13: Can I change the text of the messages patients get?
faq.a13: Yes. In Settings → Message texts you write every message and e-mail in Arabic and English, and choose where the review link goes: Google or the clinic website.
faq.q14: Does the database need a manual update after each version?
faq.a14: No. {brand} applies its database updates by itself on start and while running, and shows their state to the platform admin.
faq.q15: Can a doctor use their own e-mail?
faq.a15: Yes. Each member connects their e-mail from the mail icon at the top, then reads, replies and sends papers from their own address. Nobody else sees it, and the password is stored encrypted.
faq.q16: Can I take my patients' files with me?
faq.a16: Yes. Export one patient or every patient as a ZIP with a PDF summary, all papers and images, and portable data — then import it into any clinic on {brand}.
faq.q17: How much file storage do I get?
faq.a17: It depends on the package and is shown on the pricing page. It covers website media, patient files and chat attachments, and can be raised for your clinic when needed.
faq.q18: Can the doctor's hospital surgeries be organised?
faq.a18: Yes. The doctor or reception books the time as a "surgery" with the patient, procedure and hospital; it shows on the Surgeries page and in the patient's file, and the date goes to the hospital by e-mail or WhatsApp.

booking.text: Patients book with the clinic without choosing a doctor; reception assigns the appointment later.

messages.title: Received and confirmed messages
messages.text: An automatic WhatsApp message when a request arrives and another when it is confirmed, with texts you edit.

intake.title: Vitals from the waiting room

invoice.text: Choose whether the logo and name show, where each one goes and how big the logo is, with a live preview.

telehealth.title: Video consultations
telehealth.text: Video calls with patients from inside the appointment — no extra apps.

prices.title: Show or hide prices

dark.title: Dark mode
dark.text: A calm night-time interface for the team, and a switch to turn it on or off on the clinic website.

orders.title: Lab & imaging orders
orders.text: An editable ready list of tests and imaging the doctor picks with a click; the request prints on the clinic letterhead with signature and stamp.

referrals.title: Referrals to specialists
referrals.text: A referral letter with the specialty, the reason and a case summary, printed on the clinic letterhead and kept in the patient file.

files.title: Scan papers into the patient file
files.text: Upload scanned paper forms, lab results and imaging reports (PDF or images) so they stay with the patient’s file.

queue.title: Waiting-room screen
queue.text: A TV shows the patient going in now with the room number, then the next patient and two waiting. It refreshes every 2 seconds and chimes on every change; names are shortened for privacy.

share.title: The visit's papers in one tap
share.text: Beside each patient: prescription, lab, imaging, referral and invoice icons. Reception picks what to send and the patient gets it on WhatsApp or e-mail through a secure link in the clinic's colours, with print and save-PDF.

call.title: The doctor calls the next patient
call.text: When the doctor calls the next patient in, reception hears a ding-dong and sees a notice that stays until the patient is sent in.

review.title: Thank-you and review
review.text: A ready WhatsApp message thanks the patient and asks for a Google review, or one on the clinic's website.

chat.title: Team chat
chat.text: Messages, pictures and files between doctors, reception and nurses inside the system instead of phone groups.

specialty.title: Diagnosis table for your specialty
specialty.text: Each clinic sees only its own specialties, with a ready table of diagnosis codes that search puts first.

backup.title: An encrypted backup per clinic
backup.text: A separate daily backup of each clinic's data, encrypted and readable only on the server; one clinic can be restored without touching any other.

letterhead.title: One letterhead for every paper
letterhead.text: The same header on invoices, prescriptions, requests and referrals, with the logo size you choose and the name shown or hidden.

centres.title: Pharmacies, imaging centres and labs
centres.text: Add the places you work with and send them the prescription or the lab / imaging request on WhatsApp or e-mail through a secure link. A centre or pharmacy inside the clinic gets requests on its own list.

voice.title: The waiting screen calls patients aloud
voice.text: After the ding-dong the screen says “Lina, please go to Room 1”, with a welcome message at the top and the clinic name shown or hidden.

timer.title: Automatic consultation timer
timer.text: The timer starts when the patient goes in, can be paused and stops when the visit is finished — and shows beside each patient on Today.

texts.title: Messages in your words
texts.text: Write every message patients get — WhatsApp, SMS and e-mail — in Arabic and English; e-mails carry the clinic's logo and colours and read right to left.

carousel.title: A website with sliding rows
carousel.text: Show cards, doctors, reviews and pictures as a sliding row, with a partners logo strip and a direction that follows the language.

icons.title: Icons for your specialty
icons.text: An icon library for each specialty — over 250 icons, including a dental set drawn for {brand}.

mailbox.title: Each member's own e-mail, inside
mailbox.text: A doctor or staff member connects their e-mail (Gmail, Outlook or hosting mail), reads and replies in {brand}, and sends a prescription, report or X-ray from their own address in one click. Private to them, password encrypted; automatic messages still go from the clinic.

export.title: Export a patient's whole file
export.text: One ZIP with a PDF summary on the clinic letterhead, every prescription, report, request and invoice as PDF, and the X-rays and results as uploaded — for one patient or every patient at once.

import.title: Import puts everything back
import.text: Upload an export and every record returns to its place: visits, diagnoses, prescriptions, images. Nothing doubled, deleted records come back with their numbers — and clinics can move.

storage.title: File storage by package
storage.text: One size for all the clinic's files: website media, patient files, chat attachments. Shown in each package, and the clinic sees what each kind uses.

surgeries.title: Surgeries on their own calendar
surgeries.text: The doctor books their time as a surgery — patient, procedure, hospital. It shows on the Surgeries page by day, week and month, and in the patient's file; cancelling frees the time.

hospital.title: The surgery date to the hospital
hospital.text: Send the surgery date and the patient's details to the hospital from the clinic's e-mail or on WhatsApp in one click, in the clinic's own wording.

recurring.title: Automatic recurring expenses
recurring.text: Rent, phone and internet are recorded on their date every month — by themselves or after confirming the actual amount.

payslips.title: Payslips by e-mail
payslips.text: A PDF payslip for every staff member and doctor, sent to their e-mail from the clinic’s mail — one by one or all at once.

bank.title: Salary file for any bank
bank.text: Describe your bank’s file once (columns, order, CSV or Excel), then download it or e-mail it to the bank, with IBAN checks.

pricing.lead: Start small and move up whenever you need to. Paying yearly saves you more.

growth.consent_text: We would like to use measurement cookies on this page to understand visits and improve our ads. They load only if you accept.
growth.cookies_sub: What {brand} stores in your browser, and your choice about measurement tools on our public pages.
growth.essential_text: These keep the site working and cannot be turned off. They are not used for advertising.
growth.c_session: Keeps you signed in and protects forms (session).
growth.c_consent: Remembers your choice on this page (180 days).
growth.measure_none: {brand} does not use measurement or advertising tools at the moment. Only the essential cookies above are used.
growth.measure_text: If you accept, these tools load on {brand}'s public pages (this page and the home page) to measure visits and ad performance:
growth.measure_scope: They never load inside clinic accounts, on clinic pages, on booking pages or on sign-in pages. You can change your choice here at any time.
growth.seo_sub: How {brand} and the clinics' public pages appear in search engines, link previews and AI assistants.
growth.checks_sub: What is set up and what is still missing.

check.title: Home page title in Arabic and English
check.description: Home page description in both languages (50–170 characters)
check.faq: FAQ section on the home page (FAQPage data)
check.home_indexed: Home page open to search engines
check.clinic_details: Listed clinics have phone, address and city

fix.title: Write the title in both languages below.
fix.description: Write a description of 50–170 characters in each language.
fix.og_image: Upload an image (1200×630 works best) and choose it below.
fix.base_url: Enter the site address starting with https:// so links in the sitemap and previews are correct.
fix.verify: Paste the verification code from Google Search Console or Bing.
fix.org: Add an e-mail or phone for {brand} below.
fix.social: Add at least one profile in Social & tracking.
fix.faq: Add or show a FAQ section in the landing page editor.
fix.clinics: Clinic pages appear once a clinic finishes set-up and turns on online booking (or tick “Clinic pages”).
fix.clinic_details: {n} clinic(s) are missing a phone, address or city, so their search data is incomplete:

growth.sec_search_sub: The title and description search engines show for the home page, and the image shown when a link is shared.
growth.title_help: Empty fields use the landing page defaults shown as placeholders. Aim for about 60 characters for titles and 160 for descriptions.
growth.base_url_help: Used in canonical links, the sitemap, robots.txt and structured data. Now: {now}
growth.og_help: Shown when the home page is shared. Clinic pages use the clinic's logo.
growth.x_handle_help: Added to link previews on X.
growth.index_help: Only clinics that finished set-up and take online bookings are listed. Sign-in, booking steps, /app and /admin are never indexed.
growth.sec_verify_sub: Proves to search engines that you own the site (a meta tag on the home page).
growth.sec_aeo_sub: Machine-readable facts so search and answer engines can describe {brand} and each clinic correctly.
growth.aeo_note: The home page carries Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication and FAQPage (from the FAQ section). Each clinic page carries a MedicalClinic with its address, phone, hours text and its doctors as Physician entries — only details the clinic entered.
growth.sec_geo_sub: Which AI crawlers may read the public pages, and the summary they read at /llms.txt.
growth.bots_help: Unticked crawlers are blocked in robots.txt. Private areas are blocked for everyone.
growth.disallow_help: One path per line, starting with /. Added to robots.txt for every crawler.
growth.llms_ph: Leave empty to use the summary generated from the landing page and the listed clinics.
growth.mkt_sub: Social profiles shown in the site footer, and measurement pixels for the public marketing pages.
growth.social_sub: Shown as icons in the footer and listed as sameAs in the structured data. Full https links on each platform's own domain.
growth.pixels_sub: Paste the ID from each platform. Leave empty to turn one off.
growth.rule_pages: Only on the public marketing pages: the home page and the cookie-preferences page.
growth.rule_consent: Only after the visitor clicks Accept on the cookie notice; Reject is remembered too, and can be changed from the footer.
growth.rule_never: Never inside /app or /admin, on clinic pages, clinic sign-in or patient booking pages.
growth.rule_csp: The security policy allows each vendor only on those pages, for visitors who accepted.

pixel_help.gtm: Container ID, e.g. GTM-XXXXXXX. Tags inside it are limited by the security policy.

growth_err.file_too_big: Images must be {mb} MB or smaller.
growth_err.file_type: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image (SVG is not accepted).
growth_err.base_url: Enter the address as https://example.com (no path).
growth_err.country: Use a two-letter country code, e.g. JO.
growth_err.token: Use only the code (letters, digits, - and _).
growth_err.handle: Use up to 15 letters, digits or _.
growth_err.paths: One path per line, each starting with / (up to 30).
growth_err.media: Choose an image from the media library.
growth_err.social: Use a full https link on this platform's own site.
growth_err.pixel: This ID does not look right. Copy it again from the platform.
